sourceFindings: All 20 paper and 24 scheme pages swept. Total 360: 120 listening + 40 matching + 50 Q2 + 60 Q3 + 40 Q4 + 50 Q5. One response in each of Q4 and Q5; three internal 4B interview dates produce eight 90-mark writing products.
14 listening parts with exact 0/full tariffs. Matching CFHAGIJEBD. Original picture options, map and official Foundation 2018 recording retained.
Q2: job application by Cáit to Teach Mhucrois; Dúlainn brochure; Drochscéala gan choinne passport news. Q3: Ruth Negga article, Taibhdhearc extract, poem Solas sa Spéir with all four stanzas.

Q3A(3) accepts (Cúrsa) aisteoireachta for 6. Q3B(2): full reason 6; Chun drámaíocht a chur chun cinn / Chun Gaeilge a chur chun cinn / Drámaíocht na Gaeilge 4; Drámaíocht / Gaeilge 2. All other reading 0/full, including poem Q4 Cad atá ann? = 6; no later-year overquote exception.

Notice: 10km walk, Conor Murray, music room. Layout 1 + picture awards 8(4+4), 13(4+3+3+3), 4, 4 + language 10. Preserve walk 2/4, Irish place 4/English 0, day/date deductions, date 3ú without month 1/plain number 0, fee -2, guest name -3, room name alone 0.

Form: Síofra Ní Cheallaigh; An Siopa Ríomhaireachta, Dún Garbhán, Co. Phort Láirge. Three interview dates: 11/14/16 Bealtaine. Questions 15 + paragraph 15 + shared language 10. Questions use doubled table 30÷2; round up once (21÷2=10½→11), not every half mark. Five school subjects and three hobbies are open; at most one social-media hobby accepted. One whole 40-mark response because one Gaeilge award spans questions and paragraph.

Form paragraph: approximately 40 words; relevant to job in computer shop 15, off-topic ceiling 5. Proportional short-length deduction on paragraph award only: 30 words means 25% off awarded paragraph mark. No fixed later-year length table.

5A Turas Rothaíochta Faoin Tuath PDF16/scheme13; 5B concert PDF17/scheme14–15. No fixed later-year length table.
Scheme PDF16 language bands belong to SMM only; standard language based on structure/grammar, vocabulary/spelling. Transcripts PDF17–20; 21–23 blank, 24 cover.
